gaps.acceptance: Flow byte reader validates UTF-8 and emits exact scalar/span records from captured bytes
Flow tokenizer emits lossless token artifacts and multiple exact diagnostics
Flow can construct and traverse recursive tagged AST data through bounded arena identities
Flow parser consumes captured tokens and emits canonical AST plus structured recovery diagnostics
Flow generic map/set/list facilities pass deterministic identity and algorithm conformance
Flow symbol projection reproduces scopes, symbols and origins from captured AST
Flow canonical JSON reader/writer round-trips every public compiler artifact and rejects hostile mutations
Flow semantic analysis reproduces typed facts and complete Graph/lowering artifacts
Flow package manifests, locks and separate compilation link callable declarations to definitions deterministically
Owned, observed and borrowed resources clean up deterministically across return, failure and cancellation
Flow target-policy client resolves and validates named policy artifacts without Stage 0
Stage 1 compiler rebuilds the admitted complete source subset from public files

stages.required_evidence: Build and execute Stage 1 from captured source/package/target files
Build Stage 2 and pass the same language and artifact suites
Build Stage 3 with byte-identical authoritative artifacts or enumerated non-authority differences
